entries.results: One fold reduced ultimate strength and strain to failure about 10%; repeated-folding comparisons reported 15%/40% changes in strain to failure.
entries.limits: Strain-to-failure reductions are not silently relabelled retained tensile strength; body-armor use-time equivalence is not P3 life.

entries.limits: 95% retention at ten years is an imposed option requirement, not a sourced forecast; moisture regain and finished laminate not in dry-fibre mass.
